question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

I didn’t bought the book as I had no money.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is:** I didn’t bought**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace '**bought**' with '**buy**' to make the sentence correct.
 
• “**Did**” is the past tense of “**to do**” It requires **no dental ending** (-d, -ed, or -t) **to make it past tense**.
 
• Instead of using the **past form of buy (i.e 'bought')**, we should use the **present** form.
 
• So we should say, **I didn't buy.**__

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Corrected sentence:*** I didn’t **buy **the book as I had no money.*
